query SubscriptionsByType($type: SubscriptionType!) {
  subscriptionsByType(type: $type) {
    ...subscriptionFields
  }
}

fragment subscriptionFields on Subscription {
  id
  name
  role
  type
  description
  weight
  createDate
  updateDate
  deleteDate
  labels
  displayCardIcon
  displayCardSize
  plans {
    ...subscriptionPlanFields
  }
  discounts {
    id
    type
  }
  configuration {
    subjectIds
    categoryIds
    chatRequests
    giftChatRequests
    tasksCount
    studentsQuantityInClassroom
    unlimitedAccessToTeachersTasks
    hintsForTeachersTasks
  }
  classObjectId
  specialLabel
}

fragment subscriptionPlanFields on SubscriptionPlan {
  id
  numberOfStudents
  pricingPolicy
  period
  price
  timeline
  priceBefore
  pricePerMonth
  pricePerMonthBefore
  discount
  quotaOfTasks
  coins
  subjectPrices {
    id
    subjectId
    name
    priceBefore
    pricePerMonth
    pricePerMonthBefore
    discount
  }
  categoryPrices {
    id
    categoryId
    name
    priceBefore
    pricePerMonth
    pricePerMonthBefore
    discount
  }
}

mutation subscriptionPay($input: [PayInput!]!, $allowRecurring: Boolean, $callbackUrlTemplate: String, $amount: Float, $byCard: Boolean, $newCard: Boolean, $instantRefund: Boolean, $saveCard: Boolean, $orderObjectId: String, $userEmail: String) {
  subscriptionPay(
    input: $input
    allowRecurring: $allowRecurring
    callbackUrlTemplate: $callbackUrlTemplate
    amount: $amount
    byCard: $byCard
    newCard: $newCard
    instantRefund: $instantRefund
    saveCard: $saveCard
    orderObjectId: $orderObjectId
    userEmail: $userEmail
  ) {
    ...orderDataFields
  }
}

fragment orderDataFields on OrderData {
  Amount
  CardId
  Details
  ErrorCode
  ExpDate
  Message
  OrderId
  Pan
  PaymentId
  PaymentURL
  RebillId
  Status
  TerminalKey
}
